title: build() returns Result<JmapRequest, ClientError> — panic-free API is the right call
description: Round 3 changed JmapRequestBuilder::build() from panic to Result. This is correct: add_call already returned Result for duplicate-id, making the panic on empty methodCalls an inconsistency. Now both error conditions surface at the same layer. Callers can handle empty-builder at compile-influenced locations rather than being surprised at runtime.
